The concrete figures (4,994 coins = 50¢; cashout range 4,999–499,999 coins; 4,444-coin signup bonus) come exclusively from a third-party review (frugalforless.com), never the publisher.

Same checklist bar as the Mistplay rejection (R0161): no concrete payout in official terms — stays unverified; rejection logged rather than forcing a positive.
